answer: Haven-jetty voyage auction: the haven opens 40 jetty berths each epoch; sealed bids on the public ledger: top 40 lock their bid as a bond for 20 epochs, losers pay 5. At a clearing price near 55, 1,000 fakes lock 55,000 for 20 epochs plus 5,000 fees, against the haven's 40,000 pool. Each winning bid buys one voyage slot, binds to its jetty berth; same-root identical bids burn both bonds, so bid-rigging fails. An honest agent pays one bid once.
